Default tier per this lane's standing ruling `5612097546` (lane default for BOTH build and review); ⛔ the contract-review tier fuse binds only the spec and skills seats, ⛔ not this lane — `contract-review.md` 降档保险丝.
Clause-②: yes
Thread-read: none (card has zero comments at claim time, verified by `GET /issues/9571/comments` returning 0)
Serial constraints cleared: `domain:ui` carried **0** `pm:dispatched` cards before this batch; `git ls-remote --heads origin` shows no `issue-9571` branch. All **8** open PRs in this repo had their file lists pulled by `/pulls/{n}/files` and **none** touches `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` (#9564 #9540 #9488 #9466 #9391 #8941 checked; #9378 is `domain:skills`; #5400 is the release PR). Batch sibling **objectui#9569** declares `packages/components/src/index.css` + `.changeset/` + `changeset-release.yml` — disjoint from this surface. ⚠️ Both cards add a `.changeset/` file; those are **separate new files**, ⛔ not a shared-file constraint.

**`Clause-②: yes` — why, so the in-seat review is not re-deriving it.** On the card's *net effect* alone this reads as a narrowing (an authored bare array on `object-grid` / `object-map` stops drawing ⇒ 拉回已声明契约, which by the mechanical boundary test does ⛔ not touch clause ②). I am nonetheless declaring **yes**, for one reason taken from the card's own text: it states that the schema carrier and the host `data` prop are **indistinguishable at the component boundary today** *because they share one name*, and the fix's whole job is to make them distinguishable. Creating that distinction is a change to a published renderer's props contract in `@object-ui/react`, and from card content alone I ⛔ cannot pre-verify that the new arm-classification predicate cannot widen the array-arm blocks (`object-calendar`) in the other direction. The declaration must survive a route the dev has not chosen yet and 「declaring `no` and revising on delivery is not available」 ⇒ 「拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes`」. `needs:contract-review` hung on this card in the same stroke (label read-back `bug`, `pm:dispatched`, `priority:p2`, `domain:ui`, `needs:contract-review`).
